title: Amazing symptom tracker
body: It’s an amazing symptom tracker: easy and pleasant to use. And the white bear is adorable. As someone who suffers from several chronic problems and struggles to take care of my health consistently, it has genuinely made daily tracking something I look forward to.
author: Ginger lover friend

title: Almost perfect, couldn’t imagine not using this daily.
body:
This app has many great features, while being very customisable to every one’s personal needs and a simple interface. 
If the app could pull more data categories from other apps, like Apple health, I would give it 5 stars. 
I would like to see integration with Apple healths data for cycle tracking, medications and body measurements.
author: Je.bet

title: Ok, but PDF report is not possible..☹️
body: Great way to track all your pain and stress etc., but when it comes to how to share all the data, there is a big problem that needs to be solved. Only way to export data is to a excel sheet, and here you need to be a smart excel user, to make a right setup to be able to share all the data. It will be nice to get the possibility to print weekly, monthly, quarterly, half years and yearly reports, where data can be compared and to be able to share with doctors etc.
author: Jesper Højer

title: Not safe and private
body: Even though they write on their webpage that your stuff is encrypted, they apparently process it on their own servers. Which means that they have access to sensitive data.
author: honjohn32

title: Wonderful
body: Really helpful. Thank you for this.
author: Anders232323

title: The most comprehensive ad adaptable tracking app
body: I tested and downloaded quite a few app before arriving at Bearable. It is the app that provides me with the greatest freedom to adapt it specifically to my medical, health, mood tracking and reminding needs. Plus there is easy insights and overview. The team seems nice and responsive to feedback as well. It may take a second to find out how to customise, but you won’t find better!
author: ElegantSettings
